row: Leesburg Veterinary Hospital provides exceptional animal care that meets and exceeds the highest standards of veterinary medicine in the field. We are a full-service veterinary hospital accredited by the American Animal Hospital Association. Our services include preventative medicine and wellness care; internal medicine and ultrasound; surgery and dentistry; canine rehabilitation, and professional grooming. Besides treating dogs and cats, we also see exotic animals such as birds, reptiles, ferrets, rabbits, and other small mammals like hamsters and gerbils. Knowing that our patients are members of your family with unique health needs, we work hard to create individualized patient care and strong client communications. Your pet's comfort and quality of life are our primary concerns. We are proud to be a part of and serve the community and have been voted best Veterinary Practice in Loudoun County for 5 straight years!
